in_marathi.name: Choudhary
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Village chief or leader
in_marathi.long_meaning: Choudhary हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Choudhary is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Chaturdhar' which means 'fourfold protector' or 'four-duty bearer'. In Hindu tradition, a Choudhary was a village chief who protected and served his community in four key areas: law and order, agriculture, trade, and religion.

In Hindu tradition, a Choudhary was a village chief who protected and served his community in four key areas: law and order, agriculture, trade, and religion.
